decks.notes: The deck focuses on ramping up mana using Cloudpost and Tron lands to quickly put out powerful threats like Primeval Titan and Emrakul. It also includes cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Crop Rotation to search for key pieces, while utilizing control elements like Pithing Needle and The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with massive creatures and strong land interactions, ultimately leading to a quick victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing Gaea's Cradle as a powerful mana engine to ramp up quickly and play high-impact creatures and spells. It includes a mix of removal and disruption spells to control the board while also having access to powerful threats like Craterhoof Behemoth and Grist, the Hunger Tide. The deck also includes a toolbox of creatures to tutor for with Green Sun's Zenith and Natural Order to adapt to different situations. By efficiently generating mana and controlling the game, the deck aims to outvalue and outpace opponents in the Legacy format.

This deck focuses on using aggressive tactics and playing high risk, high reward cards like Death's Shadow and Murktide Regent to quickly overpower the opponent. It also includes disruption and protection spells such as Thoughtseize, Daze, and Force of Will to control the game and keep the opponent on their toes. The deck aims to apply pressure early on, while also being able to protect its threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan with efficient removal and counter spells.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana using land acceleration and casting big, impactful spells such as Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Maelstrom Wanderer. The main strategy involves using Creative Technique to search for powerful combo pieces like Apex Devastator and Sakashima's Protege, while also utilizing Let the Galaxy Burn to control the board. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with massive creatures and sudden bursts of damage, taking advantage of its explosive potential to win the game in a single turn.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize a combination of cards to quickly and efficiently assemble powerful combos. It includes cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Mystical Dispute to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Narset, Parter of Veils and Swords to Plowshares provide further control options. The deck focuses on card advantage and selection with Brainstorm, Ponder, and Animate Dead. Force of Will and Reanimate allow for tempo swings and the ability to revive key creatures. The deck also utilizes land-fetching cards like Flooded Strand and Polluted Delta to ensure efficient mana usage.

This deck focuses on quickly playing aggressive creatures like Death's Shadow and Murktide Regent to pressure opponents. It uses cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to find threats and disrupt opponents with cards like Thoughtseize and Daze. The deck also utilizes efficient removal like Fatal Push and Snuff Out to clear the way for its creatures. With a mix of disruption, card selection, and powerful threats, this deck aims to quickly close out games before opponents have a chance to stabilize.

This deck revolves around the combination of various cards to achieve a powerful and game-winning effect. It utilizes cards such as Let the Galaxy Burn, Creative Technique, and Emrakul, the Aeons Torn to create a devastating impact on the opponent. The inclusion of Sweet-Gum Recluse, Aurora Phoenix, and Boarding Party adds more versatility to the strategy. The deck is built with a focus on mana acceleration, using a combination of lands like Ancient Tomb, City of Traitors, Crystal Vein, and others to reach the necessary resources quickly. The deck aims to execute its combo and overwhelm the opponent with its powerful plays.

The deck focuses on quickly and aggressively dealing damage to the opponent through a combination of creatures and spells. It aims to apply constant pressure with efficient creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear, while utilizing direct damage spells such as Lava Spike, Lightning Bolt, and Fireblast to finish off the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Price of Progress and Sulfuric Vortex adds extra burn potential, while the deck's high concentration of Mountains ensures consistent access to red mana for casting spells.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively play Death's Shadow as a powerful threat while utilizing cards like Brainstorm, Daze, and Thoughtseize to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to quickly lower its own life total to make Death's Shadow stronger, while using cards like Fatal Push and Snuff Out to deal with opposing threats. The inclusion of Murktide Regent provides another big threat to close out the game, with efficient removal and disruption spells like Hymn to Tourach and Wasteland to maintain board advantage.

The deck focuses on using card advantage and fast mana acceleration to quickly deploy powerful creatures like Griselbrand, Emrakul, and Sheoldred onto the battlefield with the help of Show and Tell. It also has the ability to disrupt opponents with counter magic like Force of Will and disruption spells like Thoughtseize. The deck aims to win the game by either overwhelming the opponent with powerful threats or by comboing off with Omniscience to generate an insurmountable advantage. It has a mix of reanimation spells, card selection, and powerful threats to create a flexible and potent game plan.

This Grixis Aggro deck focuses on using efficient spells and creatures to apply constant pressure on the opponent, disrupting their game plan while quickly reducing their life total. By utilizing a mix of disruption like Thoughtseize and Force of Will, along with aggressive creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to control the battlefield and close out games swiftly. The inclusion of cards like Mishra's Bauble and Daze help to maintain card advantage and tempo advantage, while Lightning Bolt serves as both removal and reach to finish off the opponent.

Utilizing an aggressive playstyle with efficient creatures and disruptive spells, the Grixis Aggro deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and keep them on the back foot. With cheap and powerful creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, backed up by a suite of counterspells like Force of Will and Daze, the deck aims to control the tempo of the game and finish off the opponent before they can stabilize. Murktide Regent provides a powerful threat in the mid to late game, ensuring the pressure stays on the opponent throughout the match.

The main concept of this deck is to use Crop Rotation and Green Sun's Zenith to tutor for Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage, allowing you to create a 20/20 Marit Lage token in just one turn. The deck also includes cards like Elvish Reclaimer and Knight of the Reliquary to help find the combo pieces quickly. Additionally, there are cards like Sylvan Library and Mox Diamond to provide card advantage and mana acceleration. The deck aims to win the game quickly through a powerful combo while also having answers like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending to deal with threats.

The deck focuses on utilizing the combo between Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create 20/20 indestructible Marit Lage token. It also includes various ways to tutor for the combo pieces such as Green Sun's Zenith, Crop Rotation, and Elvish Reclaimer. Additional support cards like Knight of the Reliquary, Mox Diamond, and Sylvan Library provide the deck with versatility and consistency. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful creature, while also disrupting their strategies with cards like Swords to Plowshares and Collector Ouphe.

The deck focuses on utilizing Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill the opponent's library and win the game through combo. It includes cards like Goblin Engineer and Goblin Welder to tutor and reanimate key pieces. The deck also features disruption elements like Pyroblast and Red Elemental Blast to protect the combo. With mana acceleration from cards like Lotus Petal and Ancient Tomb, along with versatile removal like Lightning Bolt, the deck aims to quickly assemble the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure victory.

This combo deck revolves around using Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill the opponent's deck. The deck includes cards like Goblin Engineer and Goblin Welder to search for and recur key combo pieces. Urza's Saga is used to tutor for artifacts, while cards like Pyroblast and Red Elemental Blast provide disruption. The deck also includes mana acceleration in the form of cards like Mox Opal and Lotus Petal. The goal is to assemble the combo quickly and disrupt the opponent's game plan to win the game.
